purpose: Teach: 初代/何者/イスラム教/首長/巡礼/検閲/押収/老朽

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、王朝の、本気で、絶対、初代、絶対、皇帝、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、感心
lines.en: Sakura, I was really impressed by how thoroughly you handled the founding emperor in your dynasty paper.
lines.style: Warm recognition, slightly leaning forward with genuine interest. Measured pace. Each phrase lands with careful attention, not rushing to the next point.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。歴史上の、本気で、絶対、何者、絶対、か、絶対、不明の人物、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you. I tried to give serious treatment to that historical figure whose identity remains unclear—I really wanted to do justice to the depth of research it required.
lines.style: Quiet sincerity, slight lift of gratitude in the phrasing. Not humble-performing but genuinely engaged. Steady eye contact, natural breathing. One careful inhale before the longer clause.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 本気で、絶対、イスラム教、絶対、の歴史、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: And the way you integrated Islamic history into it was genuinely insightful.
lines.style: Reflective nod in the voice. Slower than the first line. Noticing aloud, not just complimenting. A small pause before the appreciative close—letting the observation settle.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。中東、本気で、絶対、首長、絶対、国の、絶対、経済、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Yes—I spent a lot of time on the economic structures of the Emirates, trying to show how that shaped everything else.
lines.style: Earnest technical clarity, slight acceleration on the detail-heavy section. No hesitation—she knows her material. Genuine relief in the gratitude at the close, like being seen.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 巡礼、本気で、絶対、文化、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: The pilgrimage angle was particularly well done—you showed real cultural understanding there.
lines.style: Engaged and direct. Slight warmth on "particularly." Not lecturing; affirming something she noticed and wanted to name. Light pace, conversational.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。江戸期の、本気で、絶対、検閲、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you. I connected it back to Edo-period censorship to show how cultural control worked across different systems.
lines.style: Confident now, building on the teacher's recognition. Faster, more fluid. Technical language lands naturally. Slight breathlessness near the end—pleased with how it came together.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 文化財の、本気で、絶対、押収、絶対、論文で、絶対、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: And how you traced the confiscation of cultural artifacts through those different periods—that was masterful.
lines.style: Genuine marvel in the delivery. Slight lift at "masterful." Slower tempo, lingering on the weight of what the student achieved. Not exaggerating, but letting the compliment breathe. Warm.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。本気で、絶対、老朽、絶対、文化財の、絶対、保存、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: I wanted to end with preservation of aging artifacts because that felt like the real question—how do we hold onto what matters?
lines.style: Quieter now, more reflective than before. She's moved past pleased-and-grateful to something deeper. Slight fadeout on the philosophical close. Vulnerable, not just proud. Small pause before the final phrase.
